description: THE ASYMMETRY CASE, and the sharpest single case in this file (gate G31). The account is acctdata row 6 with BOTH substitutions of case04 and case05: ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT 100.00 and ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE 2022-06-09. Both guards therefore fail, and the source runs them one after the other with no ELSE and no early exit between them: :410 stores 102, then :417 stores 103 over it, and WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC is overwritten with the longer text in the same breath. So the reject this run writes carries '0103' and 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION' - not 102, and not both. A translation that made stage three short-circuit stage four, which is the natural way to write a validation cascade and the way stages one and two genuinely behave, would emit 102 here and fail this case; nothing else in the twenty would notice, because case04 and case05 each pass under either structure.
